# **1\. Introduction**

---

## **1.1 Purpose and Scope**

Some students may need additional academic support but may feel uncomfortable asking their teacher or course instructor for help. Finding a student tutor would be much more preferable. But finding a suitable tutor can be challenging, as the student must consider the qualification and availability of the tutor and the subjects they teach.  
Meanwhile, students who wish to offer tutoring services may struggle to reach potential students through social media platforms and word of mouth.

FindTutor is a platform designed to connect students looking for academic assistance with students offering tutoring services. Users can create a tutor profile: Listing courses they teach, and their availability. Other students can search for tutors by filtering courses and tutoring times, view tutor profiles and send tutoring requests.

## **1.2 Users and Stakeholders**

| Name/role | Kind | What they need | What they fear/forbid |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Students | Primary Users | **Tutors** Being able to offer their tutoring services **Student** Be able to find suitable and available tutors | **Tutors** Fake reviews Being spammed tutoring request **Student** Unqualified tutors  |
| Course Instructors/Teachers | Secondary Stakeholder | Students being able to receive additional academic support | Inappropriate misconduct and tutors feeding incorrect information |
| University | Institution | A secure and reliable platform that is easy to maintain | Private data leaked, security vulnerabilities, and data breach |

# **2\. Overall Description**

---

## **2.1 Product Context**

| IN SCOPE (MVP this term) | OUT OF SCOPE |
| :---- | :---- |
| **FR-1** Create a tutor profile listing what courses they teach and their availability **FR-2** Search for tutors by filtering their desired courses and time **FR-3** View tutor profile and see availability, what courses the tutor teaches, and reviews **FR-4** Send/receive tutoring requests **FR-5** Leave a review after a tutoring session | Online chatting Calling Payment and subscription feature AI translator |

## **2.2 Assumptions and Constraints**

Assumption: Students have access to a device that can be connected to the internet  
Assumption: Students are willing to have a website to centralize advertising for their tutoring services

Constraints: English UI Text  
Constraints: 10-week build window  shared with four other milestones (M1-M5)

# **3\. Functional Requirements**

## **FR-1** Create a tutor profile listing what courses they teach and their availability

***User story: As a student, I want to tutor fellow students who .may need my expertise and for them to know what time I’m available and what courses I can teach, so that I may be able to tutor them effectively***

Pain this traces to: Student tutors can have some difficulty finding a fellow student that requires their help can be challenging, and even if they found one, having mismatched schedules can be even more troublesome.

1. Given courses and the available time, when the student tutor saves it, then the courses they can tutor and available time will appear on their public profile.  
2. Given an already existing profile, when the student tutor edits it, then the updated profile is shown immediately and no duplicated profile is created.

## **FR-2** Search for tutors by filtering their desired courses and time

***User story: As a student, I want to be able to find a tutor based on the courses I have listed in the filter, so that I can find a tutor that matches my needs**.*

Pain this traces to: Finding a tutor. can be hard, and it’s even harder to find a tutor that can teach in a specific subject.

1. Given the courses the student has inputted, when the student searches for a tutor, then it will show the tutors with the listed courses and hide the ones without

2. Given there are not a single tutor with the matching courses, when the student searches for a tutor, then it will inform the students that no matching tutors were found

## **FR-3** View tutor profile and see availability, what courses the tutor teaches, and reviews

***User story: As a student, I want to be able to see what time the tutor is available for tutoring, what courses the tutor teaches, and opinions of students the tutor has taught, so that I can see if the tutor is the most suitable one for me.***

Pain this traces to: Tutors and tutees have to exchange messages after meeting each other to know their availability, what courses they can effectively teach, and it doesn’t guarantee that tutor is trustworthy.

1. Given the tutor entered their schedule/availability, when the students look at their profile, then they will be able to see the available time for tutoring

2. Given the tutor is unavailable and the tutor has listed in the profile they’re not available, when the students look at the profile, then  they will see that the tutor is unavailable.

3. Given the tutor entered the course they teach, when the students look at their profile, then they will be able to see the courses the tutor teaches.

4. Given a student submits a review, when the students look at the tutor’s profile, then they will be able to see the review

## **FR-4** Send/receive tutoring requests

***User story: As a student, I want to be able  request a tutoring session to the tutor, so that I may be able to have a session with them depending on if they accepted or declined.***

Pain this traces to: Students and tutors have to use a separate messaging platform to arrange a tutoring session, which can hard to keep track of, especially if the student or tutor have many notifications filling up their screen

1. Given the student has selected a tutor with the time for the session e.g. (10:30 \- 12:25), when the student submits the request to tutor profile, then the tutor will be notified and will be able to accept or reject the request  
2. Given the student has selected the same tutor for request and they have yet to accept or reject the request,, when the student send the request, then the platform will notify that the student has already sent the request and will not send the request  
3. Given the tutor has received the request, when they accept the request, then the student will see that they have accepted the request and will be able to start chatting with the tutor online.  
4. Given the tutor has received the request, when they reject the request, then the student will be notified that the request has been rejected and will not be able to send another request for the next  15 minutes.

## **FR-5** Leave a review after a tutoring session

***User story: As a student, I want leave a review for the tutor, so other students can make informed decisions based on that review***

Pain this traces to: Students have limited information about the quality and qualifications of the tutor before they meet

1. Given the student has finished the session whether on time or early, when they submit a review and rating, then the review will appear publicly on the tutor’s profile  
2. Given the student has already submitted a review, when they edit a review and resubmit it, then the new review will appear publicly on the tutor’s profile and no duplicate review will be created

# **4\. Non-functional Requirements**

| ID | Kind | Statement (Testable) | *How we will check* |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **NFR-1** | Performance | When a student searches for a tutor, the search results will appear within 5 seconds on campus Wi-FI | Stopwatch on a device connected to campus Wi-Fi, 3 trials |
| **NFR-2** | Performance | A tutoring request will be notified to tutor within 10 seconds on campus Wi-Fi | Stopwatch with two devices connected to campus Wi-Fi, 3 trials |
| **NFR-3** | Usability | A new user should be able to search for a tutor based on a course in less than 3 steps upon opening the app | Give the app to a student who has never seen the app and tell to search for a tutor with *insert subject* and count the steps they take to find one |
| **NFR-4** | Reliability | No duplicate profile or review is created when you try to create a new profile or review | Create a profile or a review, create another one, check for any duplicates |
| **NFR-5** | Security/Privacy | When accessing a profile, user must authenticate with their password or id | Check for if the password or id matches, if not, deny access |

## **5.1. Use-case List**

## 

| Use case | Actor | Related FR | Brief success story |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| UC-1 Create a tutor profile | Student tutor | FR-1 | User creates a tutor profile with their available schedule and what courses they tutor, it will be seen publicly |
| UC-2 Looking for tutor who can teach ‘Intensive English’ | Student | FR-2 | User chooses and enters in ‘Intensive.English’in the search filter, and it shows the tutors with ‘Intensive English’ listed in their profile |
| UC-3 Show the student tutor is unavailable to the student | Student tutor → Student | FR-3 | The student tutor list in their profile that they’re unavailable, when the students look at their profile, they can see the tutor’s schedule but the tutor is currently unavailable |
| UC-4 Send a tutoring request to the tutor | Student → Student tutor | FR-4 | The user sends a tutoring request with the time they wish to schedule the tutoring  (They cannot enter a time that the tutor is unavailable during) and the tutor will be sent a notification for the tutoring request |
| UC-5 Leave a 5-star review for the tutor | Student → Student tutor | FR-5 | After the session ends based on the chosen time or both the student tutor and student chooses to end it early, the student writes a 5-star review for tutor and can be seen on the tutor profile publicly  |

# **7\. Traceability Matrix**

---

| Problem | Requirement | Design  | Implementation | Test scenario/Acceptance criteria |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Students have trouble in finding a peer tutor | FR-2 | Screen search \+ filters wireframe | Search function \+ course and time filter | Students will only see tutors who have the matching courses and time listed in their profile ❌  |
| Tutors need a way to reach out to other students and advertise their services | FR-1 | Profile creation overlay | Create profile \+ save tutor details | Create profile with courses and availability \+ profile is saved and displayed correctly ❌  |
| Students need a way to know if the tutor is qualified or not | FR-3 | Courses, availability data model \+ review overlay | Profile page displayed detailing listed courses, availability, and reviews | Open profile → The details listed by the tutor (Courses and availability) \+ Reviews will be displayed❌  |
| Students want a way to request a tutoring session from a tutor | FR-4 | Tutoring request overlay \+ request status flow | Send request \+ receive and respond to requests | Students send request → Tutor receives the request and can accept or decline it❌  |
| Students need a way to share feedback about tutors | FR-5 | Review submission overlay | Review form \+ save/display functionality | Submit review → review appears on tutor profile ❌  |
